files.header: Onyx Elm shell — abyssal monochrome + single sea-glass accent. System stack, 6px radii, hierarchy via weight/size. No gradients.

v3/gap-appearance — themes, text size, density, width, contrast and the background scene, for every surface. Loaded right after app.css.  1. Theme bridge. The shell paints with --onyx-*; the active theme (built- in, custom, or a Theme Studio session) arrives as palette tokens. The ONE derivation is Elm's ShellPalette (AA-guarded, Ocean anchored to the house cut), committed inline on <html> as --onyx-theme-<slot> (base) and --onyx-theme-hc-<slot> (high contrast). This file only selects a set; the fallbacks are the house values, so first paint is unchanged. 2. High contrast follows the Raise-contrast switch AND prefers-contrast. 3. One focus ring (--focus-ring), thicker under high contrast. 4.

elm polish/pol-stats — public /stats, /status and /roadmap pages. Ported from src/routes/{stats,status,roadmap,public-room-comparison, data-pages,landing}.css and re-cut to the Elm language: near-black surfaces, warm off-white text, 1px seams, 6px radii, no gradients or glow. The accent marks one thing here: the live/current answer (fresh feed pip, selected control, primary action, focus). Every rule is scoped to a page root so the shared `r-*` / `data-*` names cannot leak into other public pages.

v3 polish / pol-studio — the /appearance page and the Theme Studio (View.Appearance, View.Studio). Ported from src/app/appearance.css, src/backgrounds/picker/background-picker.css and the STUDIO_CSS block in src/theme/ThemeStudio.tsx, re-cut for the Elm language: near-black steps (bg / panel / panel-2) split by the 1px seam, warm off-white text, 6px radii, hierarchy by weight and size, no gradients or glow. The accent marks only the current location (bar tag), primary actions (apply / generate / bake / save) and focus. Selection is neutral: panel-2 ground + a text-coloured hairline.  The live preview mock (.ts-pv-*) deliberately paints from the THEME tokens (--ink / --stone / --paper / --lap

v3/pol-shell — production polish for the shell views (inbox, account, moderation desk, browser/formation, calls hub, rail, room header, prefs, profile, topbar identity, stewardship, switcher, notify). Ported from the Solid reference (src/shell/**, src/app/*.css) onto the Elm tokens in app.css :root. One sea-glass accent: current location, primary action, focus ring, mention glyph. 6px radii, no glow.

v3/pol-thread — the core chat surface: transcript rows, dividers, intro, typing, replies, inline media / previews / file chips, the lightbox, the thread sheet, the composer (context bars, attachments, conversation picker, outbox), message search, the media index and pins. Tokens from app.css :root only. Near-black surfaces, warm off-white text; the sea-glass accent marks current location, the primary action, focus and the mention glyph — nothing else.

v3/ui-roster — the channel member list (View.Roster).  A calm list in the Discord / Slack mould: one clean line per person (avatar with a presence dot, the full name), role sections in words with counts, Away dimmed at the end, the filter folded into an icon until it is needed, no per-row buttons on touch and a single quiet Message icon on hover / focus with a fine pointer.  Wide layouts (>= 1100px) show the list in flow as the 240px context rail. Below that the frame hides the rail and the room header's people toggle opens the same element as a popover sheet: a right side sheet on tablets, a full-height bottom sheet on phones. v3/pol-public — the public website (frame, landing, about, download, guides, invite, OnyxOS, info/trust pages, 404).  Same design language as the app shell: near-black ground, warm off-white text, ONE sea-glass accent (primary action, current location, focus), 6px radii, hierarchy by weight and size. No gradients, glow, or glass. Decorative Solid scene layers (r-ground/r-flecks/r-veins/r-grain/onyxos-grid/public-atmosphere) are intentionally not drawn. Breakpoint 768px; phone-safe at 375px.

v3/calls-c8 — calls C8 + C9 (CALLS_DESIGN.md §2.4, §2.10, §2.11, §3.4, §2.18): Hand / React / Captions in the bar, the React menu, reaction chips, the live captions plate, the push-to-talk hint and the Voice settings sheet. Tokens only from app.css :root. The accent keeps its one call meaning (live audio now) — nothing here uses it except the shared focus ring.

v3/calls-c11 — C11 stage mode (spec §2.16, oracle StagePanel) and the C12 accessibility pass over every call surface (spec §3.2–3.4, §6). Tokens come from app.css :root. Accent stays reserved for the live pip, the speaking ring and the focus ring; a raised hand is warn.

v3/polish — composer More tools tray, time scrubber, the quiet first-run notifications / Add to Home Screen sheets, and the update-available strip. Tokens only (app.css :root); the accent marks the primary action, the current hour and the focus ring.

v3/account2 — session reclaim banner, revoke-others confirm, portable residence, theme share/import sheet, You hub status block, People sheet, sidebar friend presence. Tokens come from :root in app.css.

v3/roomsettings — room header completion (privacy glyph, expandable topic, facepile, second row) and the Room settings sheet + 3.8 room surfaces (scheduled event, bridge badge, group-control mark, insights). Tokens only; accent reserved for the primary action and the focus ring.

v3/calls-c6 — DM ring dialogs (C6), mini voice view (C7) and reconnecting / error states (C10). Spec: design/calls/CALLS_DESIGN.md §2.8, §2.9, §2.14, §2.18. Tokens come from app.css :root. Accent is used only for the live pip and the speaking outline.

v3/calls-c4 — calls C4 + C5 (CALLS_DESIGN.md §2.4, §2.6, §2.7, §2.13, §2.18): camera / share / deafen controls, the connection pip and turn-off-camera prompt, the video grid, participant tiles, spotlight + screenshare layouts and stage sizes. Tokens only from app.css :root. The accent means live audio now: tile speaking border and talk bars — nothing else.

v3/gap-convo — conversation gaps: the quiet "Saved here" draft line, the file drop target, staged-photo privacy + quality, hidden-sender banner, earlier-versions disclosure, search empty state, and the pulse a row gets when a jump lands on it. Linked after pol-thread.css and before ui-sheets.css. Tokens only; flat surfaces; one accent for "this is the thing you jumped to / the choice you made".

v3/gap-account — Account protection / names, Preferences data controls (local history, saved searches, portable-vault review). Linked before ui-sheets.css so sheet-level polish still wins. Uses only the shared tokens: near-black surfaces, one accent for the primary action and focus, 6px radii, 44px targets on touch.

v3/gap-oper — the operator desk: Live feed, Bans, Silence, Abuse, Appeals, Content, Network.  One calm surface: a wide side panel on desktop, a bottom sheet on phones (the shared sheet rules), seven tabs, and inside each tab small bordered cards. The accent means one thing here — the current tab, the pressed chip, the primary action. Danger is the existing red border, never a fill. Text stays >= 14px; inputs are 16px on touch so iOS does not zoom; every control is 44px on coarse pointers.  Linked before ui-sheets.css, so every rule that has to beat a sheet rule carries its own specificity.

v3/rx-shell — the app frame on every aspect ratio.  Loaded after the pol-* files and before ui-sheets.css. v3/gap-chanserv — registered-room services and the channel-operator tools: nested disclosures in Room settings, the mask-list tabs, the join-refusal card with "Ask to join", the hosts' Invite action in the inbox, the composer's slow-mode line.  Tokens only. The accent stays on the one primary action per surface and on focus; danger is the existing --onyx-bad. Linked before ui-sheets.css so the shared sheet rules (44px touch targets under 768px, 16px fields) still win where they overlap.

v3/gap-import — history import (Preferences → Import & export) and BlockKit-lite structured messages (inline cards + their dialogs).  Linked before ui-sheets.css; every selector is namespaced (.hi-* for the import pane, .bk-* for structured messages) so nothing here can reach another surface. Calm, near-black, 1px seams, 6px radii; the one accent marks the primary action, focus and "copied". Touch targets are 44px wherever the pointer is coarse (any width).

v3/gap-people — moderation, people and room-care surfaces.  Owned by the gap-people slice; linked before css/ui-sheets.css so the sheet family keeps the last word on sheet geometry. Tokens come from app.css :root. Covers: 1. the windowed member list ("Show more", content-visibility) 2. the member card's role-gated moderation group 3. Room care (offer entry, notes) 4. the room desk (timed-block review, read-only facts) 5. Room settings tools (webhooks, transcript export)

v3/gap-organize — room folders, hidden rooms, closed conversations, saved messages, private notes, quiet hours / notification mode / smart mute, the "Since you left" digest, reader mode.  Loaded after the pol-* files and before ui-sheets.css (which owns the sheet frame: layer, veil, head, bottom-sheet behaviour). Every rule here is scoped to a gorg-* class, or to a [data-reader] / [data-testid] hook of this slice, so nothing else moves.  0. glyphs 1. Rooms / Messages lists: folders, the hidden / closed footers, the row overflow control 2. sheets: row menu, folder picker, saved messages 3. shared controls (buttons, inputs, switch) 4. member-card note, room settings, Preferences group 5. Notif

v3/gap-usermodes — privacy switches, message requests, offline messages, server blocks, account rooms, the self name, an offline person's last-seen, and the send-later "where" choice.  Loaded before ui-sheets.css (which still wins the sheet chrome). The shared `pref-*` switch/row classes are reused wherever the look is the same; everything new is `um-*`. Tokens come from :root in app.css.

=================================================================== v3/gap-commands — action rows (`/me`), the slash-commands sheet (`/help`), the single-key shortcuts switch in the `?` overlay, and the palette's Recent / People icons. Linked before ui-sheets.css: the shared sheet chrome stays theirs; only the classes below are owned here. ===================================================================

v3/gap-watch — Watch Together (View.WatchTogether): the room activity card, its details disclosure, the start editor sheet and the room More-menu entry. Linked before ui-sheets.css so the shared sheet family keeps the last word on layer, head and phone bottom sheets.  Calm by design: the card is one compact sticky bar above the transcript (panel surface, 1px seam, 6px radius); its details overlay the transcript instead of pushing it, so the reading position never jumps. The accent marks only the host's primary action (play/pause, Join / Accept / Start) and the focus ring. Icons are CSS masks over data-URI SVGs — never font glyphs. Tokens from app.css :root only.

v3/gap-shell — Activity, join-by-name, room More additions, Leave confirm, the Home network message and the connect gate's "Sign in as" action (views: src/View/GapShell.elm).  Same language as the shell: near-black panels, 1px seams, 6px radii, one accent (focus only here), kinds told by a small dot, not colour floods. Linked before ui-sheets.css, so the shared sheet frame (head, phone bottom sheet, swipe) still wins where it should; rules here are scoped to gs-* classes. Icons are CSS masks (never font glyphs).

v3/gap-auth — the sign-in steps the connect gate was missing: two-step code entry, the pre-001 CHALLENGE question and its stop screens, passkey sign-in, forgot password, and the small links the sign-in form carries. They reuse the connect card's own classes (`.conn-*`, app.css / pol-public.css); only what those do not cover is here. Linked before ui-sheets.css.

v3/gap-claim — the prompt about history from before this update (rows with no owner stamp): a Home card and a Preferences → History & data card, one decision (Attach / Not now / Delete it).  Linked before ui-sheets.css; every selector is namespaced .gc-*. Calm, near-black, a 1px seam, 6px radii; the one accent marks the primary action and focus. The card sits in the Home column (<= 720px) or the Preferences panel, so it responds to its own width (container query), not the viewport. 44px targets wherever the pointer is coarse.

v3/ui-sheets — every overlay, sheet and popover in the shell. Loaded LAST so it wins the cascade over app.css + the pol-* files.  One family: near-black panel, 1px seam, 6px radii, the short cool sheet shadow (--elev-3), a sticky head (kicker / title / subtitle, trailing actions, icon close), and on phones a true bottom sheet — grab handle, internal scroll, safe-area padding, swipe-down to dismiss (pure CSS scroll-snap, see View.Sheet). Desktop keeps centred dialogs in three widths, right-hand side panels, and a top-right popover for the inbox.  Icons are CSS masks over data-URI SVGs (never font glyphs).  v3/rx-sheets — one placement per viewport class, whatever the shell underneath does: co

v3/calls-engine + v3/rx-calls — the call surfaces at every aspect ratio. Loaded last; overrides only call classes (tokens from app.css).  Anatomy (View.CallStage): the stage is a head row (live status left; timer, people, connection and the security chip right), the people row or the video grid, then a controls-only toolbar.
